armyRules.name: Synapse
armyRules.text:
If your Army Faction is **TYRANIDS**, while a **TYRANIDS** unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly **SYNAPSE** models, that **TYRANIDS** unit is said to be within Synapse Range of that model and of your army. While a **TYRANIDS** unit from your army is within Synapse Range of your army:
▪ Each time that unit takes a Battle‑shock test, take that test on 3D6 instead of 2D6.
▪ Each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

armyRules.name: Shadow in the Warp
armyRules.text: If your Army Faction is **TYRANIDS**, once per battle, in either player’s Command phase, if one or more units from your army with this ability are on the battlefield, you can unleash the Shadow in the Warp. When you do, each enemy unit on the battlefield must take a Battle‑shock test. Each time an enemy unit takes such a Battle‑shock test, if it is within 6" of one or more **SYNAPSE** units from your army, subtract 1 from that test.

rule.name: Keywords
rule.text:
**^^Mawloc^^** and **^^Trygon^^** units from your army have the Burrower keyword.

In the Muster Armies step, you can select up to 2 **^^Trygon^^** models from your army. The selected units gain the **^^Character^^** keyword.

**Designer’s Note:** *This means that the selected models can be given Enhancements and one of them can be selected as your **^^Warlord^^**.*

rule.name: Surprise Assault
rule.text:
Each time a **^^Tyranids^^** model from your army makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

Each time a **^^Burrower^^** unit from your army is set up on the battlefield from Reserves, place a circular 40mm Tunnel Marker anywhere on the battlefield within 1" of that unit and more than 3" horizontally away from all enemy units.

In the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, when you set up a unit on the battlefield from Reserves, you can set that unit up wholly within 9" of one of your Tunnel Markers and more than 6" horizontally away from any enemy units.

If an enemy model (excluding **^^Aircraft^^**) ends any kind of move within 3" of one of your Tunnel Markers, that Tunnel Marker is removed from the battlefield.

Adaptive Optimisation.name: ADAPTIVE OPTIMISATION
Adaptive Optimisation.target: One MAWLOC or TRYGON unit from your army.
Adaptive Optimisation.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has the SYNAPSE keyword.
Adaptive Optimisation.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One MAWLOC or TRYGON unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has the SYNAPSE keyword.
Adaptive Optimisation.flavour: On occasions where subterranean assaults are deemed tactically useful, the hive mind may spontaneously alter its burrowing organisms, enabling them to act as beacons for its will.

Replenishing Swarms.name: REPLENISHING SWARMS
Replenishing Swarms.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army, wholly within 9" of one or more Tunnel Markers you placed.
Replenishing Swarms.effect: One model in your unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds, or you can return up to D3+1 destroyed models with a Wounds characteristic of 1 to your unit, with their full wounds remaining, instead.
Replenishing Swarms.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army, wholly within 9" of one or more Tunnel Markers you placed.

EFFECT: One model in your unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds, or you can return up to D3+1 destroyed models with a Wounds characteristic of 1 to your unit, with their full wounds remaining, instead.
Replenishing Swarms.flavour: Scrambling through the tunnels come endless multitudes of warrior-beasts and harvester bioforms, spilling out of the depths to reinforce the teeming masses.

Enfilading Emergence.name: ENFILADING EMERGENCE
Enfilading Emergence.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.
Enfilading Emergence.effect: Until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.

EFFECT: Until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
Enfilading Emergence.flavour: Emerging from the depths, Tyranid bioforms level their weapon morphs and spit hissing volleys of living ammunition into the exposed backs of outflanked prey.

Tunnel Network.name: TUNNEL NETWORK
Tunnel Network.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more of your Tunnel Markers and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Tunnel Network.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and set it up again, wholly within 9" of another Tunnel Marker you placed, and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
Tunnel Network.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more of your Tunnel Markers and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and set it up again, wholly within 9" of another Tunnel Marker you placed, and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
Tunnel Network.flavour: Taking advantage of freshly burrowed tunnels, Tyranid bioforms move swiftly across the landscape, emerging in unexpected locations.

Swarming Assault.name: SWARMING ASSAULT
Swarming Assault.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.
Swarming Assault.effect: Until the end of the phase, friendly TYRANIDS units within 6" of your unit can re-roll Charge rolls.
Swarming Assault.text:

TARGET: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, friendly TYRANIDS units within 6" of your unit can re-roll Charge rolls.
Swarming Assault.flavour: A hive fleet’s vanguard organisms favour mobility and aggression, keeping the foe on the back foot with repeated coordinated assaults.

Retreat Below.name: RETREAT BELOW
Retreat Below.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Retreat Below.target: One TYRANIDS unit or up to two BURROWER units from your army that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Retreat Below.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
Retreat Below.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit or up to two BURROWER units from your army that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

rule.name: Hyper Adaptions
rule.text:
At the start of the first battle round, select one of the following Hyper-adaptations to be active for **^^Tyranids^^** units from your army until the end of the battle:

**SWARMING INSTINCTS**
Each time a **^^Tyranids^^** model with this Hyper-adaptation makes an attack that targets an enemy **^^Infantry^^** or **^^Swarm^^** unit, that attack has the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.

**HYPER-AGGRESSION**
Each time a **^^Tyranids^^** model with this Hyper-adaptation makes an attack that targets an enemy **^^Monster^^** or **^^Vehicle^^** unit, that attack has the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability.

**HIVE PREDATORS**
Each time a **^^Tyranids^^** model with this Hyper-adaptation makes an attack that targets an enemy **^^Character^^** unit, if a Critical Hit is scored, that attack has the **[PRECISION]** ability.

rule.name: Sustained Hits
rule.text:
This ability always takes the form **[SUSTAINED HITS X]**. Each time an attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS]** weapon results in a **critical hit**, that attack results in a number of additional hits on the target as denoted by **X**.
***Example:** An attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** weapon results in a **critical hit**. That attack therefore hits the target three times (once from the **critical hit**, and twice more from the **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** ability).*

rule.name: Lethal Hits
rule.text:
Each time an attack made with a **[LETHAL HITS]** weapon results in a **critical hit**, you can choose for that attack to automatically wound the target. 
***Designer’s Note:** Choosing to automatically wound the target means that no **wound roll** is made for that attack. You may decide against this, as it means that attack cannot result in a **critical wound** and so cannot trigger other abilities such as [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].*

rule.name: Precision
rule.text: While resolving attacks made with one or more **[PRECISION]** weapons, at the start of the Allocation Order step (05.03), if the target unit contains one or more **CHARACTER** models **visible** to one or more of the attacking models, the active player can select one allocation group that contains one of those **visible CHARACTER** models. If they do, until those attacks are resolved, or until that **CHARACTER** group is **destroyed** (whichever happens first), that **CHARACTER** group is the current allocation group.

Rapid Regeneration.name: RAPID REGENERATION
Rapid Regeneration.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Rapid Regeneration.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Rapid Regeneration.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability instead.
Rapid Regeneration.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability instead.
Rapid Regeneration.flavour: Prey stare in horror as chitinous armour regrows and flesh, muscle and sinew knots back together.

Adrenal Surge.name: ADRENAL SURGE
Adrenal Surge.target: Up to two TYRANIDS units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army and are eligible to fight, or one other TYRANIDS unit from your army that is eligible to fight.
Adrenal Surge.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in any of those selected units makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Adrenal Surge.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: Up to two TYRANIDS units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army and are eligible to fight, or one other TYRANIDS unit from your army that is eligible to fight.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in any of those selected units makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Adrenal Surge.flavour: These warrior organisms destroy all as their adrenaline surges.

Death Frenzy.name: DEATH FRENZY
Death Frenzy.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Death Frenzy.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Death Frenzy.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Death Frenzy.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Death Frenzy.flavour: Tyranids care nothing for self-preservation, lashing out even in death.

Overrun.name: OVERRUN
Overrun.when: Fight phase, just before a TYRANIDS unit from your army Consolidates.
Overrun.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, instead of making that Consolidation move, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Overrun.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just before a TYRANIDS unit from your army Consolidates.

TARGET: That TYRANIDS unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, instead of making that Consolidation move, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Overrun.flavour: Tyranids in battle form an unstoppable avalanche of flesh and chitin that buries the foe alive.

Predatory Imperative.name: PREDATORY IMPERATIVE
Predatory Imperative.target: Up to two TYRANIDS units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other TYRANIDS unit from your army.
Predatory Imperative.effect: Select one Hyper-adaptation. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Hyper-adaptation is active for those selected units in addition to any other that may be active for your army.
Predatory Imperative.restrictions: You cannot select the same Hyper-adaptation you selected at the start of the first battle round.
Predatory Imperative.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: Up to two TYRANIDS units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other TYRANIDS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one Hyper-adaptation. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Hyper-adaptation is active for those selected units in addition to any other that may be active for your army.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select the same Hyper-adaptation you selected at the start of the first battle round.
Predatory Imperative.flavour: Guided by the instincts of leader-beasts, the swarm can be tasked with focusing its hunting instincts.

Endless Swarm.name: ENDLESS SWARM
Endless Swarm.target: Up to two ENDLESS MULTITUDE units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army.
Endless Swarm.effect: You can return up to D3+3 destroyed models to each of the selected units.
Endless Swarm.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: Up to two ENDLESS MULTITUDE units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army.

EFFECT: You can return up to D3+3 destroyed models to each of the selected units.
Endless Swarm.flavour: As the battle rages, more organisms pour in to bolster the swarms.

enhancements.text: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. While a friendly **^^Tyranids^^** unit is within 9" of the bearer, that unit is within Synapse Range of your army.

rule.name: Synaptic Imperitives
rule.text:
At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the Synaptic Imperatives shown below. Until the end of the battle round, that Synaptic Imperative is active for your army and while a **^^Tyranids^^** unit from your army is within Synapse Range of your army, it will benefit from it. Each Synaptic Imperative can only be selected once per battle.

- **Synaptic Augmentation:** While this unit is within Synapse Range of your army, models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
- **Surging Vitality:** While this unit is within Synapse Range of your army, add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit.
- **Goaded to Slaughter:** While this unit is within Synapse Range of your army, each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll

The Smothering Shadow.name: THE SMOTHERING SHADOW
The Smothering Shadow.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
The Smothering Shadow.target: One SYNAPSE unit from your army within 12" of that enemy unit.
The Smothering Shadow.effect: Roll six D6: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
The Smothering Shadow.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.

TARGET: One SYNAPSE unit from your army within 12" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Roll six D6: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
The Smothering Shadow.flavour: In the heart of the swarms, the Shadow in the Warp can literally kill with its smothering power.

Synaptic Channelling.name: SYNAPTIC CHANNELLING
Synaptic Channelling.target: One SYNAPSE unit from your army.
Synaptic Channelling.effect: Until the end of the turn, while a friendly TYRANIDS unit is within 9" of the selected unit, that unit is within Synapse Range of your army.
Synaptic Channelling.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One SYNAPSE unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, while a friendly TYRANIDS unit is within 9" of the selected unit, that unit is within Synapse Range of your army.
Synaptic Channelling.flavour: Tyranids are one with the Hive Mind; individuality is a disadvantage that they surpass.

Irresistible Will.name: IRRESISTIBLE WILL
Irresistible Will.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Irresistible Will.target: One SYNAPSE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the SYNAPSE unit.
Irresistible Will.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if the attacking model’s unit is within 6" of your SYNAPSE unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
Irresistible Will.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One SYNAPSE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the SYNAPSE unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if the attacking model’s unit is within 6" of your SYNAPSE unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
Irresistible Will.flavour: Whether paralysing its prey or forcing them to stumble out of cover with its force of will, or else puppeteering nearby warrior organisms, the leader-beast ensures the prey targets are struck down.

Reinforced Hive Node.name: REINFORCED HIVE NODE
Reinforced Hive Node.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Reinforced Hive Node.target: One SYNAPSE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Reinforced Hive Node.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Reinforced Hive Node.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Reinforced Hive Node.flavour: Psionic shielding crackles around these leader-beasts, helping to ensure their survival.

Imperative Dominance.effect: Select one Synaptic Imperative, even if you have already selected that imperative this battle. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Synaptic Imperative is active for your unit instead of any other Synaptic Imperative that is active for your army.
Imperative Dominance.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army.

EFFECT: Select one Synaptic Imperative, even if you have already selected that imperative this battle. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Synaptic Imperative is active for your unit instead of any other Synaptic Imperative that is active for your army.
Imperative Dominance.flavour: At need, the focused will of the Tyranid leader-beasts can goad warrior organisms to exhibit strategically beneficial behaviours at the instant they are needed most.

Override Instincts.name: OVERRIDE INSTINCTS
Override Instincts.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army and made a Fall Back move this phase.
Override Instincts.effect: Your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge this turn.
Override Instincts.text:

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army and made a Fall Back move this phase.

rule.name: Feed the Swarm
rule.text:
n your Command phase, each **HARVESTER** unit from your army can Regenerate one friendly **TYRANIDS** unit that is within 6" of it. A unit can only be regenerated once per phase. Each time a unit regenerates, do one of the following:
▪ One model in that unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds.
▪ One destroyed **INFANTRY** model (excluding **CHARACTERS**) is returned to that unit with its full wounds remaining. If that unit is an **ENDLESS MULTITUDE** unit, up to 3 destroyed models are returned instead.

Broodguard Impulse.name: BROODGUARD IMPULSE
Broodguard Impulse.target: One HARVESTER unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Broodguard Impulse.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your HARVESTER unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Broodguard Impulse.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One HARVESTER unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your HARVESTER unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Broodguard Impulse.flavour: Should a foe successfully slay one of the swarm’s assimilation organisms, they only mark themselves as a priority for predation and consumption in turn.

Reclaim Biomass.name: RECLAIM BIOMASS
Reclaim Biomass.when: Any phase, when a TYRANIDS unit from your army is destroyed, before the last model in it is removed from play.
Reclaim Biomass.target: One HARVESTER unit from your army that is within 6" of that destroyed unit.
Reclaim Biomass.effect: Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit within 6" of your HARVESTER unit (See Feed the Swarm).
Reclaim Biomass.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a TYRANIDS unit from your army is destroyed, before the last model in it is removed from play.

TARGET: One HARVESTER unit from your army that is within 6" of that destroyed unit.

EFFECT: Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit within 6" of your HARVESTER unit (See Feed the Swarm).
Reclaim Biomass.flavour: Dead Tyranids are consumed and reconstituted by the swarm just as readily as the lifeless carcasses of their prey.

Tyrannoformed.name: TYRANNOFORMED
Tyrannoformed.target: One HARVESTER unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
Tyrannoformed.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
Tyrannoformed.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One HARVESTER unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.

EFFECT: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
Tyrannoformed.flavour: Swarms of diminutive Tyranid phage organisms carpet even the most vital strategic assets, steadily breaking them down for assimilation.

Secure Biomass.flavour: When rich sources of biomass are identified the warrior organisms of this swarm will stop at nothing to destroy resistance and claim them.

Rapacious Hunger.name: RAPACIOUS HUNGER
Rapacious Hunger.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that just destroyed an enemy unit.
Rapacious Hunger.effect: Your unit immediately Regenerates (See Feed the Swarm). When doing so, if your unit is a HARVESTER unit and you choose for one model to regain up to D3 lost wounds, that model regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.
Rapacious Hunger.text:
WHEN: Your Fight phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that just destroyed an enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your unit immediately Regenerates (See Feed the Swarm). When doing so, if your unit is a HARVESTER unit and you choose for one model to regain up to D3 lost wounds, that model regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.
Rapacious Hunger.flavour: The hunger of the Tyranids can never be satiated.

enhancements.name: - Regenerating Monstrosity
enhancements.text: **^^Tyranids^^** model only (excluding **^^Monsters^^** models) The bearer's unit can be regenerated up to twice per phase, instead of once.

enhancements.name: - Instinctive Defence
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. While the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly HARVESTER units, when you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP. In addition, while the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly HARVESTER units, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: - Biophagic Flow (Aura)
enhancements.text: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. While a friendly **^^Harvester^^** model is within 12" of the bearer, when using the Feed the Swarm ability, that **^^Harvester^^** model can Regenerate one friendly **^^Tyranids^^** unit that is within 9" instead of one within 6".

enhancements.name: - Parasitic Biomorphology
enhancements.text: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit. The first time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase while the bearer is within 6" of one or more **^^Harvester^^** units, until the end of battle, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit.

rule.name: Enraged Behemoths
rule.text: Each time a **TYRANIDS MONSTER** model from your army makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if that model’s unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if that model’s unit is Below Half‑strength. In addition, while a **TYRANIDS MONSTER** unit from your army (excluding Battle‑shocked units) is at its Starting Strength, add 2 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

Corrosive Viscera.name: CORROSIVE VISCERA
Corrosive Viscera.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that cannot FLY is destroyed.
Corrosive Viscera.target: That TYRANIDS MONSTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Corrosive Viscera.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.
Corrosive Viscera.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that cannot FLY is destroyed.

TARGET: That TYRANIDS MONSTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.
Corrosive Viscera.flavour: Highly acidic fluids spray from the creature’s wounds, lethal to those nearby.

Rampaging Monstrosities.name: RAMPAGING MONSTROSITIES
Rampaging Monstrosities.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Rampaging Monstrosities.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Rampaging Monstrosities.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Rampaging Monstrosities.flavour: Tyranid monsters have reserves of energy that they unleash in waves of devastating fury.

Savage Roar.name: SAVAGE ROAR
Savage Roar.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Savage Roar.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Savage Roar.effect: That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If that Battle-shock test was failed, subtract 1 from the Wound roll as well.
Savage Roar.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If that Battle-shock test was failed, subtract 1 from the Wound roll as well.
Savage Roar.flavour: This monster is even more terrifying to behold than other bioforms of its kind.

Untrammelled Ferocity.name: UNTRAMMELLED FEROCITY
Untrammelled Ferocity.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Untrammelled Ferocity.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so:

- It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.

- It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after its unit has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, your unit is Battle-shocked.
Untrammelled Ferocity.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so:

- It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.

- It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after its unit has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, your unit is Battle-shocked.
Untrammelled Ferocity.flavour: Encircling and entrapping such physically powerful and fearless beasts is nigh on impossible.

Swarm-guided Salvoes.name: SWARM-GUIDED SALVOES
Swarm-guided Salvoes.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Swarm-guided Salvoes.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and until the end of the phase each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
Swarm-guided Salvoes.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and until the end of the phase each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
Swarm-guided Salvoes.flavour: One cannot hide from a gestalt entity with a million eyes, even in the densest cover.

Massive Impact.name: MASSIVE IMPACT
Massive Impact.when: Your Charge phase, just after a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army ends a Charge move.
Massive Impact.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your model and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
Massive Impact.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That TYRANIDS MONSTER model.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your model and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
Massive Impact.flavour: Employing their sheer bulk and vicious chitinous horns and spikes, the largest Tyranids crash headlong through the foe, often with devastating results.

enhancements.name: - Ominous Presence
enhancements.text: **^^Tyranids Monster^^** only. Add 3 to the bearer's Objective Control characteristic.

enhancements.name: - Enraged Reserves
enhancements.text: **^^Tyranids Monster^^** only. If the bearer is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 3+, do not remove it from play. It can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

enhancements.name: - Null Nodules
enhancements.text: **^^Tyranids Monster^^** only. Once per battle, when a Psychic Attack is allocated to the bearer, it can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

enhancements.name: - Monstrous Nemesis
enhancements.text: **^^Tyranids Monster^^** only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a **^^Monster^^** or **^^Vehicle^^** unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

rule.name: Vanguard Prime
rule.text: **^^Deathleaper^^** loses Hunter Organism rule and can be your **^^Warlord^^**.

rule.name: Questing Tendrils
rule.text: **^^Tyranids^^** units with this ability are eligible to charge in a turn in which they Fell Back. Vanguard Invader units with this ability are eligible to charge in a turn in which they Advanced.

Surprise Assault.name: SURPRISE ASSAULT
Surprise Assault.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a VANGUARD INVADER unit from your army has selected its targets.
Surprise Assault.effect: Select one enemy unit that was selected as the target of one or more of your unit’s attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the Battle-shock test was failed, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
Surprise Assault.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a VANGUARD INVADER unit from your army has selected its targets.

TARGET: That VANGUARD INVADER unit.

Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the Battle-shock test was failed, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
Surprise Assault.flavour: Vanguard organisms strike from unexpected quarters with calculated and emotionless alien savagery that is appalling to behold.

Assassin Beasts.name: ASSASSIN BEASTS
Assassin Beasts.target: One VANGUARD INVADER INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Assassin Beasts.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
Assassin Beasts.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One VANGUARD INVADER INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
Assassin Beasts.flavour: These bioforms have been adapted to strike with pinpoint precision at the pre-assessed weak points of selected prey that require elimination.

Seeded Broods.name: SEEDED BROODS
Seeded Broods.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is in Reserves, or up to two VANGUARD INVADER units from your army that are in Reserves.
Seeded Broods.effect: Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up those selected units on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.
Seeded Broods.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is in Reserves, or up to two VANGUARD INVADER units from your army that are in Reserves.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up those selected units on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.
Seeded Broods.flavour: Warrior organisms erupt from concealment straight into advanced positions.

Hypersensory Scillia.name: HYPERSENSORY SCILLIA
Hypersensory Scillia.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Hypersensory Scillia.target: Up to two VANGUARD INVADER units from your army that are within 8" of that enemy unit, or one other TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
Hypersensory Scillia.effect: Those selected units can each make a Normal move of up to 6".
Hypersensory Scillia.restrictions: You cannot target units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Hypersensory Scillia.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: Up to two VANGUARD INVADER units from your army that are within 8" of that enemy unit, or one other TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Those selected units can each make a Normal move of up to 6".

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Hypersensory Scillia.flavour: Hissing clusters of scillia warn of the slightest prey movements, allowing the Tyranids to react.

Unseen Lurkers.name: UNSEEN LURKERS
Unseen Lurkers.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Unseen Lurkers.target: One VANGUARD INVADER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Unseen Lurkers.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18" or, if your unit has the Lone Operative ability, if the attacking model is within 6". Your opponent can select new targets for the attacking unit’s attacks.
Unseen Lurkers.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One VANGUARD INVADER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18" or, if your unit has the Lone Operative ability, if the attacking model is within 6". Your opponent can select new targets for the attacking unit’s attacks.
Unseen Lurkers.flavour: Hyper-attuned senses warn vanguard organisms when they are being targeted by the prey.

Invisible Hunter.name: INVISIBLE HUNTER
Invisible Hunter.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Invisible Hunter.target: Up to two VANGUARD INVADER units from your army, or one TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit from your army.
Invisible Hunter.effect: Remove the targeted units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
Invisible Hunter.restrictions: The targeted units must be more than 3" away from all enemy units.
Invisible Hunter.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: Up to two VANGUARD INVADER units from your army, or one TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit from your army.

EFFECT: Remove the targeted units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

RESTRICTIONS: The targeted units must be more than 3" away from all enemy units.
Invisible Hunter.flavour: Hunter-slayer organisms can melt away before the eyes of their foes, only to strike from a new direction.

enhancements.name: - Hunting Grounds
enhancements.text: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time your opponent sets up a Reserves unit on the battlefield, roll one D6: on a 2+ that unit must make a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: - Chameleonic
enhancements.text: **VANGUARD INVADER** model only. This unit has **Stealth**.

enhancements.name: - Stalker
enhancements.text: **^^Vanguard Invader^^** model only. At the start of the battle, select one enemy unit. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and Wound roll.

enhancements.name: - Neuronode
enhancements.text: **TYRANIDS** model only. After both players have deployed their armies, you can select up to three **VANGUARD INVADER** units from your army and redeploy all of those units. When doing so, any of those units can be placed into Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

rule.name: Insurmountable Odds
rule.text: In your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if a model from a friendly **ENDLESS MULTITUDE** unit was **destroyed** as a result of those attacks, that friendly unit can make a **surge move** of up to D6".

Synaptic Goading.name: SYNAPTIC GOADING
Synaptic Goading.when: Any phase, just before an ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army makes a surge move.
Synaptic Goading.effect: When making that surge move, you can re-roll the D6 to determine how far your unit moves, and your unit can end that move as close as possible to the closest objective marker (instead of as close as possible to the closest enemy unit]. All other rules for making surge moves still apply.
Synaptic Goading.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just before an ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army makes a surge move.

TARGET: That ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit.

EFFECT: When making that surge move, you can re-roll the D6 to determine how far your unit moves, and your unit can end that move as close as possible to the closest objective marker (instead of as close as possible to the closest enemy unit]. All other rules for making surge moves still apply.
Synaptic Goading.flavour: For a moment, a minuscule sliver of the Hive Mind’s ineffable will is focussed through these warrior organisms, driving them to pounce upon either valuable prey or else some vital strategic target.

Unending Waves.name: UNENDING WAVES
Unending Waves.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Unending Waves.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength.
Unending Waves.restrictions: Any destroyed CHARACTER units that were attached to your unit are not returned. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
Unending Waves.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength.

RESTRICTIONS: Any destroyed CHARACTER units that were attached to your unit are not returned. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
Unending Waves.flavour: No matter how many warrior organisms are slain, more are already surging forward over their corpses.

Teeming Masses.name: TEEMING MASSES
Teeming Masses.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Teeming Masses.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Teeming Masses.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Teeming Masses.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Teeming Masses.flavour: Skittering, darting and pouring over one another, the Tyranids make for hard and confusing targets.

Swarming Masses.name: SWARMING MASSES
Swarming Masses.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Swarming Masses.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Swarming Masses.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, and If your unit contains 15 or more models, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Swarming Masses.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, and If your unit contains 15 or more models, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Swarming Masses.flavour: The sheer weight of Tyranid numbers begins to tell as they bury their victims in lashing, biting horror.

Bounding Advance.name: BOUNDING ADVANCE
Bounding Advance.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army.
Bounding Advance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
Bounding Advance.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
Bounding Advance.flavour: Synaptic impulses from the Hive Mind urge greater speed from the swarm’s warrior organisms.

Preservation Imperative.name: PRESERVATION IMPERATIVE
Preservation Imperative.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Preservation Imperative.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Preservation Imperative.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is treated as containing fewer than five models for the purpose of the [BLAST] ability.
Preservation Imperative.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit is treated as containing fewer than five models for the purpose of the [BLAST] ability.
Preservation Imperative.flavour: Triggered by incoming projectile fire, a synaptic pulse spurs the danger-senses of lesser warrior organisms and causes them to scatter like a shoal evading predators. Only once the explosions have stopped and the dust cleared do the bioforms bunch up once again.

enhancements.name: - Relentless Hunger
enhancements.text: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: - Naturalised Camouflage
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. At the start of the first battle round, select up to three friendly ENDLESS MULTITUDE units within 9" of the bearer. Until the end of the battle round, each time a ranged attack targets one of those units, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

enhancements.name: - Piercing Talons
enhancements.text: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Each time a model in the Bearer's unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: - Adrenalised Onslaught
enhancements.text: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Each time the bearer's unit makes a Pile In or Consolidation, models in this unit can move an additional 3"

rule.name: Mindhunger

- Friendly **LICTOR/NEUROLICTOR** units’ attacks that target a **CHARACTER** unit can re‑roll **hit rolls** of 1.

rule.name: Deep Strike
rule.text: Each time this unit makes an **ingress move** (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.

Counterpredation.name: COUNTERPREDATION
Counterpredation.when: Fight phase, when a friendly DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/ NEUROLICTOR/VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit is selected to fight.
Counterpredation.effect: Your unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit have +1 S and AP.
Counterpredation.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/ NEUROLICTOR/VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/NEUROLICTOR/VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit have +1 S and AP.
Counterpredation.flavour: One should never attempt to lay a trap for perfectly adapted ambush hunters, lest one become the prey in turn.

Hypersensory Adaptations.name: HYPERSENSORY ADAPTATIONS
Hypersensory Adaptations.target: One friendly DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/NEUROLICTOR/VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit.
Hypersensory Adaptations.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.
Hypersensory Adaptations.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/NEUROLICTOR/VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.
Hypersensory Adaptations.flavour: The organisms that comprise the Tyranid vanguard possess exceptionally keen senses, detecting prey no matter how well hidden it may be and relaying its location to the wider Hive Mind.

Scanner Gheist.name: SCANNER GHEIST
Scanner Gheist.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Scanner Gheist.target: One friendly unengaged DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/ NEUROLICTOR unit.
Scanner Gheist.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
Scanner Gheist.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/ NEUROLICTOR unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
Scanner Gheist.flavour: What seemed a certain and identified Tyranid contact vanishes suddenly from sight and sensors both, seemingly nothing but a ghost all along.

enhancements.name: - Encircling HorrorsUPGRADE
enhancements.text: NEUROLICTOR/LICTOR/VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit only. In your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, this unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: - Cryptophotaic CamouflageUPGRADE
enhancements.text: VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.

rule.name: Higher Imperatives
rule.text: Friendly **NORN EMISSARY/NORN ASSIMILATOR** units have the **Protean Purpose** ability.

rule.name: Protean Purpose
rule.text: (Once per battle, per unit) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit can make a selection for its **Singular Purpose** ability (this replaces the previous selection).

Catalytic Biofortification.name: CATALYTIC BIOFORTIFICATION
Catalytic Biofortification.when: Any phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR unit suffers a mortal wound.
Catalytic Biofortification.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.
Catalytic Biofortification.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That NORN ASSIMILATOR unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.
Catalytic Biofortification.flavour: Impacts and surface damage trigger explosive inflammation within this organism’s exoskeleton, spawning hardened outer layers that stave off even the most grievous hurts.

Lesser Prey.name: LESSER PREY
Lesser Prey.when: Fight phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR/NORN EMISSARY unit is selected to fight.

deathfrenzy.flavour: Tyranids care nothing for self-preservation, lashing out even in death.

overrun.name: OVERRUN
overrun.when: Fight phase, just before a TYRANIDS unit from your army Consolidates.
overrun.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, instead of making that Consolidation move, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".
overrun.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just before a TYRANIDS unit from your army Consolidates.

TARGET: That TYRANIDS unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, instead of making that Consolidation move, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".
overrun.flavour: Tyranids in battle form an unstoppable avalanche of flesh and chitin that buries the foe alive.

predatoryimperative.name: PREDATORY IMPERATIVE
predatoryimperative.target: Up to two TYRANIDS units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other TYRANIDS unit from your army.
predatoryimperative.effect: Select one Hyper-adaptation. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Hyper-adaptation is active for those selected units in addition to any other that may be active for your army.
predatoryimperative.restrictions: You cannot select the same Hyper-adaptation you selected at the start of the first battle round.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select the same Hyper-adaptation you selected at the start of the first battle round.
predatoryimperative.flavour: Guided by the instincts of leader-beasts, the swarm can be tasked with focusing its hunting instincts.

endlessswarm.name: ENDLESS SWARM
endlessswarm.target: Up to two ENDLESS MULTITUDE units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army.
endlessswarm.effect: You can return up to D3+3 destroyed models to each of the selected units.
endlessswarm.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

endlessswarm.flavour: As the battle rages, more organisms pour in to bolster the swarms.

corrosiveviscera.name: CORROSIVE VISCERA
corrosiveviscera.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that cannot FLY is destroyed.

corrosiveviscera.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.

EFFECT: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.
corrosiveviscera.flavour: Highly acidic fluids spray from the creature’s wounds, lethal to those nearby.

rampagingmonstrosities.name: RAMPAGING MONSTROSITIES
rampagingmonstrosities.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
rampagingmonstrosities.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
rampagingmonstrosities.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
rampagingmonstrosities.flavour: Tyranid monsters have reserves of energy that they unleash in waves of devastating fury.

savageroar.name: SAVAGE ROAR
savageroar.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
savageroar.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
savageroar.effect: That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If that Battle-shock test was failed, subtract 1 from the Wound roll as well.
savageroar.text:

savageroar.flavour: This monster is even more terrifying to behold than other bioforms of its kind.

untrammelledferocity.name: UNTRAMMELLED FEROCITY
untrammelledferocity.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
untrammelledferocity.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so:

- It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.

- It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after its unit has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, your unit is Battle-shocked.
untrammelledferocity.text:

TARGET: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

- It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after its unit has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, your unit is Battle-shocked.
untrammelledferocity.flavour: Encircling and entrapping such physically powerful and fearless beasts is nigh on impossible.

swarmguidedsalvoes.name: SWARM-GUIDED SALVOES
swarmguidedsalvoes.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
swarmguidedsalvoes.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and until the end of the phase each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
swarmguidedsalvoes.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and until the end of the phase each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
swarmguidedsalvoes.flavour: One cannot hide from a gestalt entity with a million eyes, even in the densest cover.

massiveimpact.name: MASSIVE IMPACT
massiveimpact.when: Your Charge phase, just after a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army ends a Charge move.
massiveimpact.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your model and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
massiveimpact.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That TYRANIDS MONSTER model.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your model and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
massiveimpact.flavour: Employing their sheer bulk and vicious chitinous horns and spikes, the largest Tyranids crash headlong through the foe, often with devastating results.

synapticgoading.name: SYNAPTIC GOADING
synapticgoading.when: Any phase, just before an ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army makes a surge move.
synapticgoading.effect: When making that surge move, you can re-roll the D6 to determine how far your unit moves, and your unit can end that move as close as possible to the closest objective marker (instead of as close as possible to the closest enemy unit]. All other rules for making surge moves still apply.
synapticgoading.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just before an ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army makes a surge move.

TARGET: That ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit.

EFFECT: When making that surge move, you can re-roll the D6 to determine how far your unit moves, and your unit can end that move as close as possible to the closest objective marker (instead of as close as possible to the closest enemy unit]. All other rules for making surge moves still apply.
synapticgoading.flavour: For a moment, a minuscule sliver of the Hive Mind’s ineffable will is focussed through these warrior organisms, driving them to pounce upon either valuable prey or else some vital strategic target.

unendingwaves.name: UNENDING WAVES
unendingwaves.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
unendingwaves.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength.
unendingwaves.restrictions: Any destroyed CHARACTER units that were attached to your unit are not returned. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
unendingwaves.text:

TARGET: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.

RESTRICTIONS: Any destroyed CHARACTER units that were attached to your unit are not returned. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
unendingwaves.flavour: No matter how many warrior organisms are slain, more are already surging forward over their corpses.

teemingmasses.name: TEEMING MASSES
teemingmasses.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
teemingmasses.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
teemingmasses.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
teemingmasses.text:

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
teemingmasses.flavour: Skittering, darting and pouring over one another, the Tyranids make for hard and confusing targets.

swarmingmasses.name: SWARMING MASSES
swarmingmasses.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
swarmingmasses.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
swarmingmasses.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, and If your unit contains 15 or more models, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
swarmingmasses.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, and If your unit contains 15 or more models, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
swarmingmasses.flavour: The sheer weight of Tyranid numbers begins to tell as they bury their victims in lashing, biting horror.

boundingadvance.name: BOUNDING ADVANCE
boundingadvance.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army.
boundingadvance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
boundingadvance.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
boundingadvance.flavour: Synaptic impulses from the Hive Mind urge greater speed from the swarm’s warrior organisms.

preservationimperative.name: PRESERVATION IMPERATIVE
preservationimperative.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
preservationimperative.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
preservationimperative.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is treated as containing fewer than five models for the purpose of the [BLAST] ability.
preservationimperative.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit is treated as containing fewer than five models for the purpose of the [BLAST] ability.
preservationimperative.flavour: Triggered by incoming projectile fire, a synaptic pulse spurs the danger-senses of lesser warrior organisms and causes them to scatter like a shoal evading predators. Only once the explosions have stopped and the dust cleared do the bioforms bunch up once again.

broodguardimpulse.name: BROODGUARD IMPULSE
broodguardimpulse.target: One HARVESTER unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
broodguardimpulse.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your HARVESTER unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
broodguardimpulse.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One HARVESTER unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your HARVESTER unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
broodguardimpulse.flavour: Should a foe successfully slay one of the swarm’s assimilation organisms, they only mark themselves as a priority for predation and consumption in turn.

reclaimbiomass.name: RECLAIM BIOMASS
reclaimbiomass.when: Any phase, when a TYRANIDS unit from your army is destroyed, before the last model in it is removed from play.
reclaimbiomass.target: One HARVESTER unit from your army that is within 6" of that destroyed unit.
reclaimbiomass.effect: Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit within 6" of your HARVESTER unit (See Feed the Swarm).
reclaimbiomass.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a TYRANIDS unit from your army is destroyed, before the last model in it is removed from play.

TARGET: One HARVESTER unit from your army that is within 6" of that destroyed unit.

EFFECT: Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit within 6" of your HARVESTER unit (See Feed the Swarm).
reclaimbiomass.flavour: Dead Tyranids are consumed and reconstituted by the swarm just as readily as the lifeless carcasses of their prey.

tyrannoformed.name: TYRANNOFORMED
tyrannoformed.target: One HARVESTER unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
tyrannoformed.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
tyrannoformed.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One HARVESTER unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.

EFFECT: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
tyrannoformed.flavour: Swarms of diminutive Tyranid phage organisms carpet even the most vital strategic assets, steadily breaking them down for assimilation.

ablativecarapace.name: ABLATIVE CARAPACE
ablativecarapace.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
ablativecarapace.target: One HARVESTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
ablativecarapace.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, until the end of the phase models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.
ablativecarapace.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HARVESTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, until the end of the phase models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.
ablativecarapace.flavour: These organisms have employed consumed minerals to exude an additional hardened protective layer over their chitinous armour.

securebiomass.name: SECURE BIOMASS
securebiomass.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
securebiomass.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a HARVESTER unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit as well.
securebiomass.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a HARVESTER unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit as well.
securebiomass.flavour: When rich sources of biomass are identified the warrior organisms of this swarm will stop at nothing to destroy resistance and claim them.

rapacioushunger.name: RAPACIOUS HUNGER
rapacioushunger.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that just destroyed an enemy unit.
rapacioushunger.effect: Your unit immediately Regenerates (See Feed the Swarm). When doing so, if your unit is a HARVESTER unit and you choose for one model to regain up to D3 lost wounds, that model regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.
rapacioushunger.text:
WHEN: Your Fight phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that just destroyed an enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your unit immediately Regenerates (See Feed the Swarm). When doing so, if your unit is a HARVESTER unit and you choose for one model to regain up to D3 lost wounds, that model regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.
rapacioushunger.flavour: The hunger of the Tyranids can never be satiated.

surpriseassault.name: SURPRISE ASSAULT
surpriseassault.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a VANGUARD INVADER unit from your army has selected its targets.
surpriseassault.effect: Select one enemy unit that was selected as the target of one or more of your unit’s attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the Battle-shock test was failed, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
