Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the Battle-shock test was failed, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
surpriseassault.flavour: Vanguard organisms strike from unexpected quarters with calculated and emotionless alien savagery that is appalling to behold.

assassinbeasts.name: ASSASSIN BEASTS
assassinbeasts.target: One VANGUARD INVADER INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
assassinbeasts.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
assassinbeasts.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One VANGUARD INVADER INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
assassinbeasts.flavour: These bioforms have been adapted to strike with pinpoint precision at the pre-assessed weak points of selected prey that require elimination.

seededbroods.name: SEEDED BROODS
seededbroods.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is in Reserves, or up to two VANGUARD INVADER units from your army that are in Reserves.
seededbroods.effect: Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up those selected units on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.
seededbroods.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is in Reserves, or up to two VANGUARD INVADER units from your army that are in Reserves.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up those selected units on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.
seededbroods.flavour: Warrior organisms erupt from concealment straight into advanced positions.

hypersensoryscillia.name: HYPERSENSORY SCILLIA
hypersensoryscillia.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
hypersensoryscillia.target: Up to two VANGUARD INVADER units from your army that are within 8" of that enemy unit, or one other TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
hypersensoryscillia.effect: Those selected units can each make a Normal move of up to 6".
hypersensoryscillia.restrictions: You cannot target units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
hypersensoryscillia.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: Up to two VANGUARD INVADER units from your army that are within 8" of that enemy unit, or one other TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Those selected units can each make a Normal move of up to 6".

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
hypersensoryscillia.flavour: Hissing clusters of scillia warn of the slightest prey movements, allowing the Tyranids to react.

unseenlurkers.name: UNSEEN LURKERS
unseenlurkers.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
unseenlurkers.target: One VANGUARD INVADER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
unseenlurkers.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18" or, if your unit has the Lone Operative ability, if the attacking model is within 6". Your opponent can select new targets for the attacking unit’s attacks.
unseenlurkers.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One VANGUARD INVADER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18" or, if your unit has the Lone Operative ability, if the attacking model is within 6". Your opponent can select new targets for the attacking unit’s attacks.
unseenlurkers.flavour: Hyper-attuned senses warn vanguard organisms when they are being targeted by the prey.

invisiblehunter.name: INVISIBLE HUNTER
invisiblehunter.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
invisiblehunter.target: Up to two VANGUARD INVADER units from your army, or one TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit from your army.
invisiblehunter.effect: Remove the targeted units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
invisiblehunter.restrictions: The targeted units must be more than 3" away from all enemy units.
invisiblehunter.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: Up to two VANGUARD INVADER units from your army, or one TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit from your army.

EFFECT: Remove the targeted units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

RESTRICTIONS: The targeted units must be more than 3" away from all enemy units.
invisiblehunter.flavour: Hunter-slayer organisms can melt away before the eyes of their foes, only to strike from a new direction.

thesmotheringshadow.name: THE SMOTHERING SHADOW
thesmotheringshadow.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
thesmotheringshadow.target: One SYNAPSE unit from your army within 12" of that enemy unit.
thesmotheringshadow.effect: Roll six D6: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
thesmotheringshadow.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.

TARGET: One SYNAPSE unit from your army within 12" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Roll six D6: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
thesmotheringshadow.flavour: In the heart of the swarms, the Shadow in the Warp can literally kill with its smothering power.

synapticchannelling.name: SYNAPTIC CHANNELLING
synapticchannelling.target: One SYNAPSE unit from your army.
synapticchannelling.effect: Until the end of the turn, while a friendly TYRANIDS unit is within 9" of the selected unit, that unit is within Synapse Range of your army.
synapticchannelling.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One SYNAPSE unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, while a friendly TYRANIDS unit is within 9" of the selected unit, that unit is within Synapse Range of your army.
synapticchannelling.flavour: Tyranids are one with the Hive Mind; individuality is a disadvantage that they surpass.

irresistiblewill.name: IRRESISTIBLE WILL
irresistiblewill.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
irresistiblewill.target: One SYNAPSE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the SYNAPSE unit.
irresistiblewill.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if the attacking model’s unit is within 6" of your SYNAPSE unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
irresistiblewill.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One SYNAPSE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the SYNAPSE unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if the attacking model’s unit is within 6" of your SYNAPSE unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
irresistiblewill.flavour: Whether paralysing its prey or forcing them to stumble out of cover with its force of will, or else puppeteering nearby warrior organisms, the leader-beast ensures the prey targets are struck down.

reinforcedhivenode.name: REINFORCED HIVE NODE
reinforcedhivenode.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
reinforcedhivenode.target: One SYNAPSE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
reinforcedhivenode.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
reinforcedhivenode.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One SYNAPSE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
reinforcedhivenode.flavour: Psionic shielding crackles around these leader-beasts, helping to ensure their survival.

imperativedominance.name: IMPERATIVE DOMINANCE
imperativedominance.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army.
imperativedominance.effect: Select one Synaptic Imperative, even if you have already selected that imperative this battle. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Synaptic Imperative is active for your unit instead of any other Synaptic Imperative that is active for your army.
imperativedominance.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army.

EFFECT: Select one Synaptic Imperative, even if you have already selected that imperative this battle. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Synaptic Imperative is active for your unit instead of any other Synaptic Imperative that is active for your army.
imperativedominance.flavour: At need, the focused will of the Tyranid leader-beasts can goad warrior organisms to exhibit strategically beneficial behaviours at the instant they are needed most.

overrideinstincts.name: OVERRIDE INSTINCTS
overrideinstincts.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army and made a Fall Back move this phase.
overrideinstincts.effect: Your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge this turn.
overrideinstincts.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army and made a Fall Back move this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge this turn.
overrideinstincts.flavour: The seemingly omniscient Hive Mind processes the sensory input of its swarms at an impossible rate, and compels its broods to react accordingly.

adaptiveoptimisation.name: ADAPTIVE OPTIMISATION
adaptiveoptimisation.target: One MAWLOC or TRYGON unit from your army.
adaptiveoptimisation.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has the SYNAPSE keyword.
adaptiveoptimisation.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One MAWLOC or TRYGON unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has the SYNAPSE keyword.
adaptiveoptimisation.flavour: On occasions where subterranean assaults are deemed tactically useful, the hive mind may spontaneously alter its burrowing organisms, enabling them to act as beacons for its will.

replenishingswarms.name: REPLENISHING SWARMS
replenishingswarms.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army, wholly within 9" of one or more Tunnel Markers you placed.
replenishingswarms.effect: One model in your unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds, or you can return up to D3+1 destroyed models with a Wounds characteristic of 1 to your unit, with their full wounds remaining, instead.
replenishingswarms.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army, wholly within 9" of one or more Tunnel Markers you placed.

EFFECT: One model in your unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds, or you can return up to D3+1 destroyed models with a Wounds characteristic of 1 to your unit, with their full wounds remaining, instead.
replenishingswarms.flavour: Scrambling through the tunnels come endless multitudes of warrior-beasts and harvester bioforms, spilling out of the depths to reinforce the teeming masses.

enfiladingemergence.name: ENFILADING EMERGENCE
enfiladingemergence.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.
enfiladingemergence.effect: Until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
enfiladingemergence.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.

EFFECT: Until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
enfiladingemergence.flavour: Emerging from the depths, Tyranid bioforms level their weapon morphs and spit hissing volleys of living ammunition into the exposed backs of outflanked prey.

tunnelnetwork.name: TUNNEL NETWORK
tunnelnetwork.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more of your Tunnel Markers and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
tunnelnetwork.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and set it up again, wholly within 9" of another Tunnel Marker you placed, and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
tunnelnetwork.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more of your Tunnel Markers and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and set it up again, wholly within 9" of another Tunnel Marker you placed, and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
tunnelnetwork.flavour: Taking advantage of freshly burrowed tunnels, Tyranid bioforms move swiftly across the landscape, emerging in unexpected locations.

swarmingassault.name: SWARMING ASSAULT
swarmingassault.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.
swarmingassault.effect: Until the end of the phase, friendly TYRANIDS units within 6" of your unit can re-roll Charge rolls.
swarmingassault.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, friendly TYRANIDS units within 6" of your unit can re-roll Charge rolls.
swarmingassault.flavour: A hive fleet’s vanguard organisms favour mobility and aggression, keeping the foe on the back foot with repeated coordinated assaults.

retreatbelow.name: RETREAT BELOW
retreatbelow.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
retreatbelow.target: One TYRANIDS unit or up to two BURROWER units from your army that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
retreatbelow.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
retreatbelow.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit or up to two BURROWER units from your army that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
retreatbelow.flavour: The network of tunnels beneath the battlefield enables Tyranid organisms to retreat from the foe and prepare further ambushes.

counterpredation.name: COUNTERPREDATION
counterpredation.when: Fight phase, when a friendly DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/ NEUROLICTOR/VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit is selected to fight.
counterpredation.effect: Your unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit have +1 S and AP.
counterpredation.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/ NEUROLICTOR/VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/NEUROLICTOR/VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit have +1 S and AP.
counterpredation.flavour: One should never attempt to lay a trap for perfectly adapted ambush hunters, lest one become the prey in turn.

hypersensoryadaptations.name: HYPERSENSORY ADAPTATIONS
hypersensoryadaptations.target: One friendly DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/NEUROLICTOR/VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit.
hypersensoryadaptations.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.
hypersensoryadaptations.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/NEUROLICTOR/VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.
hypersensoryadaptations.flavour: The organisms that comprise the Tyranid vanguard possess exceptionally keen senses, detecting prey no matter how well hidden it may be and relaying its location to the wider Hive Mind.

scannergheist.name: SCANNER GHEIST
scannergheist.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
scannergheist.target: One friendly unengaged DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/ NEUROLICTOR unit.
scannergheist.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
scannergheist.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/ NEUROLICTOR unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
scannergheist.flavour: What seemed a certain and identified Tyranid contact vanishes suddenly from sight and sensors both, seemingly nothing but a ghost all along.

catalyticbiofortification.name: CATALYTIC BIOFORTIFICATION
catalyticbiofortification.when: Any phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR unit suffers a mortal wound.
catalyticbiofortification.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.
catalyticbiofortification.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That NORN ASSIMILATOR unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.
catalyticbiofortification.flavour: Impacts and surface damage trigger explosive inflammation within this organism’s exoskeleton, spawning hardened outer layers that stave off even the most grievous hurts.

lesserprey.name: LESSER PREY
lesserprey.when: Fight phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR/NORN EMISSARY unit is selected to fight.
lesserprey.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have +2 S.
lesserprey.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR/NORN EMISSARY unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That NORN ASSIMILATOR/NORN EMISSARY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have +2 S.
lesserprey.flavour: Focused on achieving its assigned imperative, this towering bioform smashes prey from its path with glad‑driven surges of additional might.

tanglestrikerounds.name: TANGLESTRIKE ROUNDS
tanglestrikerounds.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR unit has shot.
tanglestrikerounds.effect:
Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is tethered until the start of your next Command phase:

- While a unit is tethered, that unit has -2" M.
tanglestrikerounds.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR unit has shot.

TARGET: That NORN ASSIMILATOR unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is tethered until the start of your next Command phase:

- While a unit is tethered, that unit has -2" M.
tanglestrikerounds.flavour: These revolting living shells burst on impact to ensnare nearby prey organisms in a mess of dripping, incredibly sticky strands that take time to tear free of.

alienphysiology.name: ALIEN PHYSIOLOGY
alienphysiology.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly TYRANID WARRIORS unit.
alienphysiology.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
alienphysiology.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly TYRANID WARRIORS unit.

TARGET: That TYRANID WARRIORS unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
alienphysiology.flavour: The sheer resilience of these warrior organisms appears nighsupernatural to their horrified prey.

synapticmicronodes.name: SYNAPTIC MICRONODES
synapticmicronodes.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
synapticmicronodes.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly TYRANID WARRIORS unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
synapticmicronodes.flavour: Shed like spores from chitinous exoskeletons, these micronodes infest the very battlefield with minute motes of the Hive Mind’s consciousness.

parasiticpayload.name: PARASITIC PAYLOAD
parasiticpayload.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly TYRANID WARRIORS unit is selected to shoot.
parasiticpayload.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORE COVER].
parasiticpayload.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly TYRANID WARRIORS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That TYRANID WARRIORS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORE COVER].
parasiticpayload.flavour: The projectiles fired by this weapon are infected with parasites that burrow into the central nervous systems of their targets, causing them to shriek and convulse, giving away their position to the oncoming swarms.

bioacidsurge.name: BIO-ACID SURGE
bioacidsurge.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army and has not been selected to fight this phase.
bioacidsurge.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
bioacidsurge.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army and has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
bioacidsurge.flavour: Triggered by synaptic imperative, these warrior organisms'weapon limbs secrete dripping gouts of virulent bio-acid.

phagicspores.name: PHAGIC SPORES
phagicspores.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
phagicspores.target: One TYRANID WARRIORS WITH MELEE BIO-WEAPONS or TYRANID WARRIORS WITH RANGED BIO-WEAPONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
phagicspores.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed as a result of an attack, do not remove it from play; after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, roll one D6: on a 3-5, the closest enemy unit within 3" of and visible to your unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 6, the closest enemy unit within 3" of and visible to your unit suffers 2 mortal wounds. The destroyed model is then removed from play.
phagicspores.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One TYRANID WARRIORS WITH MELEE BIO-WEAPONS or TYRANID WARRIORS WITH RANGED BIO-WEAPONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed as a result of an attack, do not remove it from play; after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, roll one D6: on a 3-5, the closest enemy unit within 3" of and visible to your unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 6, the closest enemy unit within 3" of and visible to your unit suffers 2 mortal wounds. The destroyed model is then removed from play.
phagicspores.flavour: In death, these warrior organisms release billowing clouds of hideously corrosive spores that reduce nearby prey to bubbling organic slicks.

expendablebiomass.name: EXPENDABLE BIOMASS
expendablebiomass.target: One TYRANID WARRIORS WITH RANGED BIO-WEAPONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
expendablebiomass.effect: Select one enemy unit that is visible to your unit and within Engagement Range of one or more friendly ENDLESS MULTITUDE or RIPPER SWARMS units. Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to make ranged attacks against that enemy unit as if it was not within Engagement Range of those friendly units. When doing so, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and, after your unit has finished making its attacks, each of those friendly units that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
expendablebiomass.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One TYRANID WARRIORS WITH RANGED BIO-WEAPONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit that is visible to your unit and within Engagement Range of one or more friendly ENDLESS MULTITUDE or RIPPER SWARMS units. Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to make ranged attacks against that enemy unit as if it was not within Engagement Range of those friendly units. When doing so, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and, after your unit has finished making its attacks, each of those friendly units that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
expendablebiomass.flavour: The Tyranids will expend the lives of their lesser organisms in droves provided it results in their prey’s defeat.

hivesight.name: HIVE SIGHT
hivesight.target: One TYRANIDS SYNAPSE unit from your army and one friendly TYRANIDS unit that has not declared a charge this phase.
hivesight.effect: Select one enemy unit that is visible to your SYNAPSE unit. Until the end of the phase, each time your other unit declares a charge, it can include that enemy unit as a target of that charge, even if it is not visible to it, and when doing so, add 1 to the Charge roll.
hivesight.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS SYNAPSE unit from your army and one friendly TYRANIDS unit that has not declared a charge this phase.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit that is visible to your SYNAPSE unit. Until the end of the phase, each time your other unit declares a charge, it can include that enemy unit as a target of that charge, even if it is not visible to it, and when doing so, add 1 to the Charge roll.
hivesight.flavour: It is whispered amongst the fearful prey species that if one Tyranid can see you, they all can...

lithekillers.name: LITHE KILLERS
lithekillers.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
lithekillers.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
lithekillers.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
lithekillers.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
lithekillers.flavour: These warrior organisms employ agility and stealth in place of resilience, weaving around their victims' blows and exploiting the tangled internal structures of the voidship to their advantage.

adrenalisedslaughter.name: ADRENALISED SLAUGHTER
adrenalisedslaughter.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
adrenalisedslaughter.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
adrenalisedslaughter.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 5+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
adrenalisedslaughter.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 5+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
adrenalisedslaughter.flavour: These organisms contain additional adrenal biomorphs, which send them into a final killing frenzy just before death.

talontipswarm.name: TALON-TIP SWARM
talontipswarm.when: Fight phase, just after a TYRANIDS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
talontipswarm.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 3". After that move, if your unit is within range of an objective marker and no enemy units are within range of that objective marker, that objective marker is Secured by your army.
talontipswarm.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a TYRANIDS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: That TYRANIDS unit.

EFFECT: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 3". After that move, if your unit is within range of an objective marker and no enemy units are within range of that objective marker, that objective marker is Secured by your army.
talontipswarm.flavour: As they break the prey's lines, these organisms seek key strategic sites to tear apart.

predatorypounce.name: PREDATORY POUNCE
predatorypounce.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit opens a Hatchway.
predatorypounce.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within 3" of that Hatchway and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
predatorypounce.effect: Your unit can make a Pounce move. To do so, your unit can be moved up to 3", but must end that move as close as possible to that Hatchway. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, but only that enemy unit.
predatorypounce.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit opens a Hatchway.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within 3" of that Hatchway and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Pounce move. To do so, your unit can be moved up to 3", but must end that move as close as possible to that Hatchway. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, but only that enemy unit.
predatorypounce.flavour: The internal hatchways of prey voidships make excellent ambush sites for vanguard organisms.

livingavalanche.name: LIVING AVALANCHE
livingavalanche.when: Your Movement phase, just after a TYRANIDS unit from your army has opened a Hatchway.
livingavalanche.effect: Your unit can make a Swarm move. To do so, your unit can be moved up to 3", but at least one model from your unit must end that move on the opposite side of that Hatchway from the one it started the phase on. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of enemy units.
livingavalanche.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a TYRANIDS unit from your army has opened a Hatchway.

TARGET: That TYRANIDS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Swarm move. To do so, your unit can be moved up to 3", but at least one model from your unit must end that move on the opposite side of that Hatchway from the one it started the phase on. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of enemy units.
livingavalanche.flavour: This hatchway does not so much slide open as burst asunder like a breached dam, warrior organisms spilling forth from it in a heaving mass.

squirmingmasses.name: SQUIRMING MASSES
squirmingmasses.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
squirmingmasses.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that is in Reserves.
squirmingmasses.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Deep Strike ability and, when setting them upon the battlefield using that ability, they can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, provided they are also within Synapse Range of your army.
squirmingmasses.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once and, until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
squirmingmasses.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that is in Reserves.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Deep Strike ability and, when setting them upon the battlefield using that ability, they can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, provided they are also within Synapse Range of your army.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once and, until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
squirmingmasses.flavour: Like water flowing through every available gap and channel, the Tyranids squeeze through ducts and vents to spill out in the midst of the prey.

swarmhunters.name: SWARM HUNTERS
swarmhunters.target: One TERMAGANTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
swarmhunters.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can ignore other models in their unit for the purposes of determining visibility. In addition, if your unit is within Synapse Range of your army, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
swarmhunters.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One TERMAGANTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can ignore other models in their unit for the purposes of determining visibility. In addition, if your unit is within Synapse Range of your army, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
swarmhunters.flavour: These Termagants act like a single, many-limbed, many-weaponed organism, squirming around one another to level the most firepower possible.

onrushinghorde.name: ONRUSHING HORDE
onrushinghorde.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
onrushinghorde.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army (excluding WINGED TYRANID PRIME units), that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
onrushinghorde.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
onrushinghorde.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit from your army (excluding WINGED TYRANID PRIME units), that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
onrushinghorde.flavour: Surging toward their victims in a swift mass of screeching maws and lashing talons, the Tyranids are a panic-inducing sight.

hyperadrenalreflexes.name: HYPERADRENAL REFLEXES
hyperadrenalreflexes.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
hyperadrenalreflexes.target: One GREAT DEVOURER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
hyperadrenalreflexes.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
hyperadrenalreflexes.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One GREAT DEVOURER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
hyperadrenalreflexes.flavour: Goaded by the biostimulants surging through their bodies, these warrior organisms evade their enemies'attacks with unbelievable swiftness.

pervasivedread.name: PERVASIVE DREAD
pervasivedread.when: Fight phase, just after the enemy WARLORD is destroyed (and is not returned to the battlefield) by a GREAT DEVOURER unit from your army.
pervasivedread.effect: In your opponent’s next Command phase, each enemy unit on the battlefield must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result. This Stratagem cannot cause a unit to take two Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
pervasivedread.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after the enemy WARLORD is destroyed (and is not returned to the battlefield) by a GREAT DEVOURER unit from your army.

TARGET: That GREAT DEVOURER unit.

EFFECT: In your opponent’s next Command phase, each enemy unit on the battlefield must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result. This Stratagem cannot cause a unit to take two Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
pervasivedread.flavour: With the death of their leader, the surviving prey feel an ominous sense of doom press down upon them, heightened by subtle psionic assault.

huntinggrounds.name: HUNTING GROUNDS
huntinggrounds.when: Your Movement phase, just after a GREAT DEVOURER unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
huntinggrounds.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3", provided at least one of its models ends that move on the opposite side of that Hatchway from when your unit opened it.
huntinggrounds.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a GREAT DEVOURER unit from your army opens a Hatchway.

TARGET: That GREAT DEVOURER unit.

outflank.target: One GENESTEALERS or PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit from your army that is wholly within an Entry Zone.
outflank.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. It will arrive back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase.
